lines.text: Five rectangles, perimeter sixty-six, no side lengths!
lines.caption: Five rectangles, perimeter sixty-six, no side lengths!

lines.text: Five identical rectangles make one big rectangle.
lines.caption: Five identical rectangles make one big rectangle.

lines.text: Its perimeter is sixty-six. What's the area of one small rectangle?
lines.caption: Its perimeter is sixty-six. What's the area of one small rectangle?

lines.text: Look! Two long sides on top match three short sides below.
lines.caption: Look! Two long sides on top match three short sides below.

lines.text: Say short is two blocks, long is three. Both rows are six blocks wide!
lines.caption: Say short is two blocks, long is three. Both rows are six blocks wide!

lines.text: Around is twenty-two blocks. Sixty-six over twenty-two: one block is three!
lines.caption: Around is twenty-two blocks. Sixty-six over twenty-two: one block is three!

lines.text: Short is six, long is nine. The area is fifty-four!
lines.caption: Short is six, long is nine. The area is fifty-four!
